mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM message WHERE to_id = #{userId} AND is_read = 0

SELECT m.id, m.from_id, m.to_id, m.goods_id, m.content, m.is_read, m.create_time, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM message WHERE from_id = m.from_id AND to_id = #{toId} AND is_read = 0) AS unread_count FROM message m INNER JOIN ( SELECT from_id, MAX(create_time) AS max_time FROM message WHERE to_id = #{toId} GROUP BY from_id ) latest ON m.from_id = latest.from_id AND m.create_time = latest.max_time WHERE m.to_id = #{toId} ORDER BY m.create_time DESC
SELECT * FROM message WHERE to_id = #{toId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT * FROM message WHERE (from_id = #{userId1} AND to_id = #{userId2}) OR (from_id = #{userId2} AND to_id = #{userId1}) ORDER BY create_time ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO message (from_id, to_id, goods_id, content) VALUES (#{fromId}, #{toId}, #{goodsId}, #{content})
mapper.update: UPDATE message SET is_read = 1 WHERE from_id = #{fromId} AND to_id = #{toId}
